The default driver is SQLite. NewDBDriver selects sqlite.NewDB based on the driver profile.

store.CreateMemo delegates to driver.CreateMemo, which routes to sqlite.DB.CreateMemo to execute the INSERT. The store path and driver switch were traced to confirm this candidate.

message.text: Searching for the CreateMemo method to identify which concrete code executes the SQL INSERT when a memo is saved.

The concrete method is `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`.

The default driver is SQLite via viper and cobra defaults. NewDBDriver selects sqlite.NewDB when profile.Driver is "sqlite". Store.CreateMemo delegates to driver.CreateMemo.

h12.
sqlite.DB.CreateMemo — store/db/sqlite/memo.go; default driver is sqlite (cmd/memos/main.go), selected by NewDBDriver (store/db/db.go)

With no DB flags, `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` and the `--driver` default are both `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go`). `db.NewDBDriver` then constructs `sqlite.NewDB`. `Store.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go`) calls `s.driver.CreateMemo`, so the INSERT that runs is `func (d *DB) CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (`INSERT INTO \`memo\``). MySQL and Postgres have the same method, but they are not selected on a default install.
